public_message: Deal accepted at Rs.16,500 per tonne for 70 tonnes, delivered as discussed.
private_reasoning: The buyer's offer of Rs.16,500/t is well above our private floor of Rs.13,500/t and ensures we keep the feedstock moving, preserving the critical three‑party loop. Accepting the 70 t volume meets their demand and maintains our margins while avoiding disposal costs. This secures the deal and supports the broader supply chain.
